notes: A context pack, the Apple app's own export (ContextPack.swift), pasted back in. One message contains a '---' line of its own.

Apple has no parser for its own export: the header block becomes a Note, every message keeps a trailing '---', the '**Note:**' turn is glued to the previous message, and title, link, tags and summary are lost. OPTIONAL for the web app (data-model.md prefers the interchange format for transfers): a parser that reads the format back into title, provider, model, link, tags, summary and clean messages.
